laura_infra: Heads up — ap-southeast1 pool seeing a cluster of orphaned extents that never get cleaned. Several GPU attach failures spiking. Anyone else seeing this?

mike_sre: yup noticed attach errors around 03:38 UTC, was digging into janitor traces. GPUs queue but disk I/O for scrub spikes and attach times out.

laura_infra: Janitor logs show sweep claimed to delete files but metastore commit returns busy/timeout, so marks aren't persisted. Node sample: gnode-az3-047.

laura_infra: ```
[2026-03-19T03:40:12Z] janitor: sweep complete, deleted=214, duration=2.1s
[2026-03-19T03:40:12Z] metastore: commit failed: EBUSY (meta-lock timeout)
[2026-03-19T03:40:12Z] janitor: mark-orphan failed extent=e-9f2a retry=1
[2026-03-19T03:40:14Z] janitor: retry exhausted, skipping extent=e-9f2a
```

ops-bot: [AUTOMATED] scratchpool_pressure at 0.82 (threshold 0.7) — gpu-provisioning degraded. See metrics: https://graf.redwood.internal/d/local_nvme_write_iops

kyra_devex: is the issue that janitor thinks it's done but the metadata commit never landed? that would leave the extent referenced but not reclaimable, right? :thinking_face: 

laura_infra: exactly. janitor deletes FS entries then asks metastore to mark extents reclaimed. metastore lock contention means reclaim marker not written, so extents still show up in allocator. Meanwhile background writebacks + retry churn causes write amplification on the NVMe -> thermal and iops spike.

tom_platform: can we run a reconcile pass that scans for extents flagged in FS but missing metastore marks and fix them? I have a quick tool:
`./tools/extent-reconcile --node gnode-az3-047 --fix-orphans`

sangeeta_research: +1 on reconcile. Also proposing a small metastore patch: if commit fails with EBUSY, enqueue an async durable write instead of bubbling immediate success to janitor. That avoids janitor assuming deletion succeeded. I'll open a PR with the change.

mike_sre: running reconcile on 047 now (dry-run) — found 128 orphaned extents, ~3.4GB, mostly small chunks. Dry-run output: `orphan_count=128 orphan_bytes=3670016000`.

mike_sre: starting fix on 047 -> will throttle to avoid triggering scrub surge. schedule: 04:30 UTC for 048/052 after we validate 047.

kyra_devex: if fixes succeed, we should add a health probe that alerts when janitor reports deletions but metastore commit latency > 500ms. Might catch this earlier.

laura_infra: agreed. Also adding temporary rule: limit concurrent janitor workers per node to 2 to reduce meta-lock contention.

ops-bot: Deployment: reconcile job started on gnode-az3-047 by mike_sre at 04:02 UTC.

mike_sre: fix completed on 047. orphan_count_fixed=128 reclaimed=3.4GB. IOPS back to baseline, attach failures cleared. Rolling to 048/052 at 04:30.

laura_infra: creating postmortem stub and will include timeline + PR for metastore retry-mode. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

tom_platform: follow-up action items: 1) backfill reconcile as on-demand tool 2) metastore PR 3) alert for inconsistent-delete anomaly. I'll add to infra backlog.

sangeeta_research: PR opened: metastore async-commit-on-busy — link: https://git.redwood.internal/r/metastore/pulls/1423

laura_infra: closing loop — monitor for 24h then we can revert janitor worker limit if stable.

mike_sre: noted. metrics look good so far.

laura_infra: thanks team — will post final postmortem here when complete.
